ModMetaData.name: RimScent Extended: Everyday Life Expansion
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Cooking, coffee, bread, brewing, flowers, books and knick-knacks. The smells of a room people actually live in.
COOKING, WITHOUT NAMING A SINGLE STOVE Every cooking station in the game and in every mod smells of cooking — reached through the isMealSource marker the game already uses, not a hand-written list. An unpowered stove smells of nothing. The nutrient paste dispenser gets its own, considerably less appetising smell.
FLOWERS, THE SAME WAY Every decorative plant, vanilla or modded, through its purpose="Beauty" marker. One xpath covers 62 plants across the installed mods, and will cover the next one you install without an update.
VANILLA ITEMS Beer and wort — that is fermentation, like the barrel and the brewery. Hay, hops and herbal medicine: cut plants drying in the air. Scattered documents smell of paper, not of dirt.
MOD INTEGRATION — each part loads only if the mod it targets is active - VBE Coffees and Teas: coffee and tea, roasting and brewing. - Vanilla Cooking Expanded - Bakery: baking bread. - Stoneborn Cuisine: the grill, the dwarven oven, the portable pot and the quantum microgenerator all smell of cooking; the meat dryer of drying meat; the tallow hearth of the meal rather than the fuel, because it is a cooking station. - Alpha Crafts: scented candles, soap, essences, vinegar, worn perfume. Its essences take the name of their ingredient at runtime, so the smell is deliberately generic. - Knick Knacks, Colonists' Deco, Tabletop Trove: air fresheners, houseplants, old paper on shelves and in books, taxidermy heads. Props that sat there decoratively now do something.
Ships in English with a French translation injected on top. No save data.
Requires RimScent and RimScent Extended.
